verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs say it aggregates occurrences of the same error into Items using a default grouping algorithm, and markets this as 'Intelligent error grouping'. Custom Fingerprinting Rules let developers override grouping when occurrences are wrongly split or combined, and item merging offers a further manual correction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of grouping accuracy, and explicit first-party detail that the default fingerprint is stack-trace-based (only implied via the linked grouping-algorithm page).
